AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. D — Ice melting to water

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

5. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.

7. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

10. C — newton (N)

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

12. C — 100 °C
